issues.description: Developer.monthsOfSwiftExperience is specified as Int? in the problem statement and template, but implemented as Double? in the solution. This breaks the intended integer-based logic (e.g., switching on exactly 1 month and incrementing by 1) and can cause test/type incompatibilities.
issues.suggestedFix: In the solution, change monthsOfSwiftExperience back to Int? and update all dependent code accordingly: `var monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?`, `init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?)`, switch cases on Int, and increment using Int arithmetic.

issues.description: Developer initializer parameter type for monthsOfSwiftExperience differs: the problem statement/template require `init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?)`, but the solution uses `init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Double?)`. This creates a signature mismatch against the specified API and likely tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution initializer signature to `init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?)` to match the problem statement/template (and adjust stored property type to Int?).
